share.title: Sharing
share.orgHint: Everyone in the org answers inside the app after signing in.
share.publicHint: Anyone with the link answers without signing in. Sending is rate limited against spam.

share.oneResponseHint: Each person can answer the form once.
share.oneResponsePublic: Each browser can answer once (people are unknown on a public link).

deliver.notifyHint: The form's owner gets a notification for each answer.

deliver.tableNew: Create a table from the questions
deliver.tableCreated: Table created; answers go there once you save.
